---
title: "Feedback inbox"
---

The live queue from `FEEDBACK.md`. Add notes from any page with the ✎
button in the bottom-right corner (the page name is tagged
automatically), or from the form below. Saying *"apply my feedback"* to
Claude — or running `/thesis-feedback` — applies every open item to the
source files and moves it to the Applied log.

This console only works on the local preview with the feedback server
running; on the published site it shows nothing.

```{=html}
<div id="fbc" style="max-width:100%">
  <div style="border:1px solid #ddd;border-radius:8px;padding:12px;margin-bottom:16px">
    <div style="display:flex;gap:8px;margin-bottom:8px">
      <input id="fbc-page" type="text" placeholder="Page (e.g. roadmap, platform notes)"
             style="flex:1;padding:6px;font:inherit;border:1px solid #ccc;border-radius:6px">
    </div>
    <textarea id="fbc-text" placeholder="What should change?"
              style="width:100%;height:80px;box-sizing:border-box;font:inherit;padding:6px;border:1px solid #ccc;border-radius:6px"></textarea>
    <div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;margin-top:8px">
      <span id="fbc-status" style="color:#555;font-size:13px"></span>
      <button id="fbc-send" style="border:1px solid #2760aa;background:#2760aa;color:#fff;border-radius:6px;padding:6px 14px;cursor:pointer;font:inherit">Queue note</button>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:baseline">
    <h3 style="margin:0">Current queue</h3>
    <button id="fbc-refresh" style="border:1px solid #ccc;background:#fff;border-radius:6px;padding:4px 10px;cursor:pointer;font:inherit;font-size:13px">Refresh</button>
  </div>
  <pre id="fbc-view" style="white-space:pre-wrap;background:#f8f8f8;border:1px solid #eee;border-radius:8px;padding:12px;margin-top:8px;font-size:13px">Loading…</pre>
</div>
<script>
(function () {
  var API = "http://127.0.0.1:4211/feedback";
  var view = document.getElementById("fbc-view");
  var status = document.getElementById("fbc-status");

  function load() {
    fetch(API).then(function (r) { return r.text(); }).then(function (t) {
      view.textContent = t;
    }).catch(function () {
      view.textContent = "Feedback server not reachable (127.0.0.1:4211).\n" +
        "This console works on the local preview only, with the " +
        "'thesis-feedback-server' running.";
    });
  }

  document.getElementById("fbc-refresh").addEventListener("click", load);
  document.getElementById("fbc-send").addEventListener("click", function () {
    var note = document.getElementById("fbc-text").value.trim();
    var page = document.getElementById("fbc-page").value.trim() || "site";
    if (!note) { status.textContent = "Write a note first."; return; }
    status.textContent = "Saving…";
    fetch(API, {
      method: "POST",
      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      body: JSON.stringify({ page: page, path: "", note: note })
    }).then(function (r) { return r.json(); }).then(function (d) {
      if (d.ok) {
        document.getElementById("fbc-text").value = "";
        status.textContent = "Queued ✓";
        load();
      } else {
        status.textContent = "Error: " + (d.error || "unknown");
      }
    }).catch(function () {
      status.textContent = "Feedback server not running.";
    });
  });

  load();
})();
</script>
```
